name: no client role can read or write any analytics table; RLS enabled and forced; no policies
function privileges: ingest = service_role only; dashboard/refresh = signed-in only; rollup/purge = nobody
owner gets the report; a signed-in non-owner, a token without a user, anon and service_role are refused
only catalogued events with allow-listed, well-typed properties are stored; each rejection is counted by reason
bad envelopes: unknown env, empty, oversize (>20) and non-array batches are refused without storing anything
a replayed event id is stored once and counted as a duplicate (sendBeacon + retry)
per-session cap (500 / 24 h), bot flag, skewed client clock, client error counters
sessionisation: 30-minute gap splits a session; landing/exit pages; channels; engaged flag; time cap; bots flagged
daily rollup matches the hand-computed answers; re-running it changes nothing (idempotent)
owner report: KPIs, previous-period comparison, date filter boundaries, environment separation, funnel, health
empty range returns zeros, not errors; refresh is owner-only and rolls up today
purge deletes raw events older than 90 days (rolling them up first) and keeps the daily rollup
Stripe figures: pending with no data, still pending with TEST-mode data only, live figures from billing tables only
handler: live origin -> live env; preview origin -> test; localhost -> dev; UA reduced to a family; always 204
handler: refuses foreign origins, GET, oversize bodies, >20 events, junk JSON, rate-limit overflow and the kill switch; never errors
handler: database down -> still 204, nothing thrown (the page never sees a failure)
